name: Can Fin Homes Ltd
title: Can Fin Homes Ltd - 511196 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 disbursements hit record INR3,245 crore and FY27 guidance of INR13,000 crore disbursement with 14% AUM growth, spreads held at 2.75% guided, but growth is in housing-finance rundown-heavy book with prepayments elevated.

triggers.label: Q4 disbursement record INR3,245 crore
triggers.quote: with Q4 ending at an all-time high of INR3,245 crores
triggers.highlight: Q4 ending at an all-time high of INR3,245 crores

triggers.label: Spread guided 2.75% with 85% on quarterly reset
triggers.quote: the entire 50 basis points has been passed on to our customers
triggers.highlight: entire 50 basis points has been passed on

triggers.label: Prepayment rundown INR7,000 crore FY27 vs INR6,600 crore FY26
triggers.quote: We have also considered only INR7,000 crores for FY '27 as against INR6,600 crores approximately for FY '26.

triggers.label: AUM growth FY27 about 14%
triggers.quote: which would result in about a 14% AUM growth

triggers.label: Affordable segment slowing to mid-single digit
triggers.quote: affordable definitely has is now in the mid-single-digit numbers
triggers.highlight: affordable definitely has is now in the mid-single-digit numbers

guidance.quote: with a INR13,000 crores disbursement target that we have kept for the year
which would result in about a 14% AUM growth
we therefore continue the guidance of 2.75% spread and 3.75% on the NIM for the FY '27
we would still like to continue with the guidance of 15 basis points
we hope to be able to maintain our ROA of 2.4%
we hope to have an ROE of 18% plus

prior_guidance_check.quote: disbursement marginally in excess of that figure of INR10,531 crores
it has been about 10 basis points for the current year as a whole

red_flags.label: Prepayment/BT-out leakage to LIC and Bajaj
red_flags.quote: The key players who are doing the BT out is LIC Housing and Bajaj.

red_flags.label: Affordable segment demand slowing
red_flags.quote: definitely affordable is impacted in terms of demand

evasions.quote: I wouldn't want to get into that.
